subject: [PATCH v9 7/7] mm/memcontrol: restrict memory stock to leaf cgroups on v2

2026-11-13.patch_summary: This patch restricts memory stock to leaf cgroups in the new page_counter_stock world of cgroup v2. It prevents unused stock from accumulating in non-leaf cgroups by stopping stock refills and scheduling drains on CPUs that are not isolated. The patch also changes behavior for processes that charge directly to interior cgroups, no longer stocking them. This is done to prevent stranding unusable charges in parent cgroups.
